info.description: Browser clients use the Next.js BFF, not these bearer endpoints directly. No match/reward write endpoints. All private replies are no-store. Native proofs are domain-separated Ed25519; signing tuple is defined in shared/src/web_account.rs.

get.summary: Verify the current Ekza library connection
get.description: Owner-bound library consent, serialized across sessions. Does not publish or admit game assets. An upstream outage preserves encrypted consent and normally returns 200 with state unavailable; migration 005 missing also returns unavailable. A new connect upstream failure returns 503 ekza_unavailable. Explicit upstream 401/410 clears revoked or expired consent. No query parameters accepted.

200.description: Current whitelisted connection state, including unavailable.

delete.summary: Forget the local encrypted Ekza library grant
delete.description: Owner-bound library consent, serialized across sessions. Does not publish or admit game assets. An upstream outage preserves encrypted consent and normally returns 200 with state unavailable; migration 005 missing also returns unavailable. A new connect upstream failure returns 503 ekza_unavailable. Explicit upstream 401/410 clears revoked or expired consent. No query parameters accepted. DELETE has an empty body. Forgetting here does not revoke the upstream Studio grant.
